Who we are

Born at Ibn Battouta High School.
Built for something bigger.

World in Words Battouta operates today within our school, while laying the foundations for a wider debate and public-speaking community — one that can eventually welcome students from other schools through inter-school debates, conferences, and tournaments.

We're not only here to win debates. We're here to learn how to speak, listen, research, question, reason, persuade, disagree respectfully, and lead.

Our philosophy

Different voices.
One community.

A strong debate isn't about silencing another voice. It's about understanding different perspectives, challenging ideas, and building stronger arguments — together.

"Disagreement, handled well, is how ideas get stronger."
"That's exactly why we attack arguments — never people."

What we do

Six ways we build speakers and thinkers

Debate

Structured discussions designed to challenge arguments, improve reasoning, and teach participants how to respond under pressure.

Public speaking

Training focused on confidence, delivery, articulation, and stage presence in front of any audience.

Research

Digging into evidence and sources so every argument stands on something real, not assumption.

Workshops

Hands-on sessions on rhetoric, structure, and the craft of building a persuasive case.

Competitions

Tournament-format debates that put training into practice, at school and — soon — beyond it.

Conferences

Larger gatherings for discussion, exchange, and the community we're building toward.
